'''Jumara 2 (January 20)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Galina Casban]] is forced to swear obedience to the [[Shaido]] [[Wise One]]s on an [[Oath Rod]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Graendal]] is visited by [[Moghedien]], [[Lanfear|Cyndane]], and [[Shaidar Haran]] and is told that [[Moridin]] is the [[Nae'blis]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] makes a pact with [[Sorilea]] to teach [[Rand]] about laughter and tears again. Sorilea shows Cadsuane how to travel.
*[[1000 NE]] - Rand subdues some remnants of [[Sammael]]'s army. He then learns of the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] army and the [[Seanchan]]'s attack plans against [[Illian]].
